summary: WebSocket real-time notifications feature fully tested. All core functionality working: WebSocket endpoint accepts connections, plan change messages are broadcast correctly, toast notifications appear, persistent banner with correct colors (green for upgrade, amber for downgrade), dismiss button works, subscription context auto-refreshes. P0 bug fix regression verified.

issues: React hydration warning: <tr> inside <span> and <span> inside <tbody> (development warning, not blocking)

passed_tests: PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/user_public_default correctly changes plan and returns audit log
WebSocket message is sent to connected clients when plan changes (type: 'plan_changed')
Toast notification appears with 'Plan Upgraded!' or 'Plan Changed' title and correct description
Persistent banner appears below header with data-testid='plan-change-banner'
Banner shows green/emerald styling for upgrades (basic → premium)
Banner shows amber styling for downgrades (premium → pro)
Dismiss button (X) with data-testid='plan-change-banner-dismiss' removes the banner
Subscription context auto-refreshes after receiving WebSocket plan change event (badge updates from 'Basic Plan' to 'Premium Plan')
WebSocket reconnects automatically after disconnection (5 second delay)
POST /api/knowledge-base/add-to-board enforces school limits - P0 bug fix regression PASSED
Invalid plan name correctly rejected with 400
critical_code_review_comments: React hydration warnings in Dashboard.js - <span> wrappers around <tr> elements causing HTML validation issues. Minor issue, doesn't affect functionality.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all WebSocket notification features verified via Playwright)

test_credentials: No credentials needed - auth is MOCKED (get_current_user returns static user user_public_default)
seed_data_creation: User has 15 schools on board. Tests change plan via PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/user_public_default

WebSocket URL: wss://<host>/api/ws/tenant_public_default. To test: 1) Open app 2) Call PUT /api/admin/subscriptions/user_public_default with {plan: 'premium'} 3) Verify toast and banner appear. User currently on basic plan.
